item.text:
The documented refund is **5.70**. The **5.69 refund is a rounding bug**.

The [refund rule](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/docs/behavior/returns/submit-return.md:10) says: “The refund is the price paid for the returned items, with the order's discount applied and rounded half up to the cent.” Its example explicitly gives **8.50 with 33% off → 5.70**.

I reproduced the current behavior: [the code](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/src/returns.ts:24) produces `569.4999999999999` cents through floating-point arithmetic, then rounds to **569 cents**. The correct calculation is **5.695 → 5.70**.

No fix spec exists yet; I can start one for refund rounding.
